spec._note: One concrete website, priced identically everywhere. Vague specs are how cost comparisons get rigged, so this is fixed before any price is looked up.
spec.name: A small production web app
assumptions: Always-on, not scale-to-zero — a site that sleeps is a different product.
One region, US East, no multi-region or HA.
Managed Postgres where the provider sells it; self-managed on the same box where they do not.
500 GB/month egress is the figure used in video 103, kept for comparability.
No CDN tier, no WAF, no support plan.
